ATC-INT-10.input: Call the admin API with an ordinary account, run the one-time make-admin command on the server, then call again
ATC-INT-10.expected: Refused before the command, accepted after it

ATC-INT-11.input: A doctor registers through the API, tries the specialist screens, the administrator approves, the doctor tries again
ATC-INT-11.expected: No access while pending; access to the specialist API after approval

ATC-INT-12.input: The administrator adds a nutritionist by email
ATC-INT-12.expected: Account created without any password; role and public profile created

ATC-INT-13.input: A signed-in member (the phone) lists specialists, holds a time, pays
ATC-INT-13.expected: The booking becomes a request with the payment recorded and the time kept
ATC-INT-13.area: Booking and payment by the phone

ATC-INT-14.input: The doctor opens the request, then accepts it
ATC-INT-14.expected: Request visible without the patient's data; after accepting a video room exists and the member is told
ATC-INT-14.area: Specialist accepts and the room is created

ATC-INT-15.input: The doctor opens My patients and the patient's record
ATC-INT-15.expected: The patient is listed and the record opens

ATC-INT-16.input: The doctor sets a diet plan and a workout plan; the member then reads and tries to write them
ATC-INT-16.expected: Member can read both but the database refuses any write

ATC-INT-17.input: The nutritionist reviews a day of the shared food log inside the sharing window
ATC-INT-17.expected: The verdict is stored and the member sees it

ATC-INT-18.expected: Future bookings cancelled and freed, patient told, sign-in deleted

ATC-INT-19.input: The administrator deletes another specialist, then tries an administrator and themselves
ATC-INT-19.expected: The specialist is deleted; the other two are refused

ATC-INT-20.input: Read the database without signing in, then as a member read and write protected nodes
ATC-INT-20.expected: Every read and write refused by the real database rules

ATC-INT-21.input: A member holds a free time; a second member tries the same time
ATC-INT-21.expected: First hold succeeds; the second is refused

ATC-INT-22.input: Holds with a wrong patient id, a wrong fee, a hold over ten minutes, a made-up specialist and a past time

ATC-INT-23.input: Pay a hold with matching and non-matching amounts; a member tries to confirm or add a link
ATC-INT-23.expected: Correct payment turns the hold into a request; wrong amounts and self-confirmation refused

ATC-INT-24.input: An administrator sets a platform fee; a member pays with and without it
ATC-INT-24.expected: Only the exact fee is accepted

ATC-INT-25.input: A third party and the two involved people read an appointment; a member edits notes and another member's booking
ATC-INT-25.expected: Only the two involved can read; edits refused

ATC-INT-26.input: Cancel a held and a requested booking; take over an expired hold
ATC-INT-26.expected: Times freed; the expired hold can be taken over

ATC-INT-27.input: After the specialist accepts, the member reads, tries to cancel after the start and to rewrite the booking
ATC-INT-27.expected: Reading allowed; cancelling after the start and rewriting refused

ATC-INT-28.input: A member keeps and deletes their own saved card tokens and tries to touch other card data
ATC-INT-28.expected: Own tokens allowed; anything else about cards refused

ATC-INT-29.input: A specialist changes fee or slot length after a booking; the member pays or cancels
ATC-INT-29.expected: The member is not locked out

ATC-INT-30.input: A member reads and tries to write specialist plans and reviews; sets the plan choice
ATC-INT-30.expected: Reads only their own; writes refused; the plan choice is theirs

ATC-INT-31.input: Run create-admin; sign in with the saved login; call the admin API
ATC-INT-31.expected: The login works, the file is private and the password is never printed

ATC-INT-32.input: Run create-admin a second time for the same email, then with a reset
ATC-INT-32.expected: Password and file unchanged unless a reset is requested

ATC-INT-33.input: An ordinary member calls the admin API; create-admin on an existing member account
ATC-INT-33.expected: Refused; the existing member account is not hijacked
